opts: cells of the proximal convoluted tubule
juxtaglomerular cells of the afferent arteriole
questions.why: The juxtaglomerular (granular) cells secrete renin; the macula densa senses tubular NaCl and signals them.

questions.q: The Parkland formula for fluid resuscitation in burns is:
opts: 4 mL × body weight (kg) × % burn in 24 hours, half in the first 8 hours
questions.why: Topic 9, Surgery, ENT, Eye and First Aid. Ringer's lactate is used.

questions.q: Bilious diarrhoea and stitching right-sided liver pains relieved by lying on the right side, with jaundice, suggest:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Chelidonium: pain under the right scapula, liver remedy.

questions.q: Hahnemann held (§119) that one medicine can never be a substitute (succedaneum) for another because:
opts: medicines from the same family act alike
only the dose decides the action
substitutes are forbidden by the law of potency
every medicine has its own peculiar and distinct action
questions.why: §119: as every plant species differs, each medicine has a distinct action, so none can replace another.

questions.q: Convulsions with opisthotonus and risus sardonicus, with the mind clear between the fits, suggest poisoning by:
questions.why: Strychnine blocks glycine inhibition in the spinal cord, causing tetanic convulsions while consciousness is preserved between fits.

questions.q: Surfactant in the lungs is secreted by:
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. Its lack causes respiratory distress in preterm babies.

questions.q: Pancreatic trypsinogen is activated in the duodenum by:
questions.why: Enterokinase from the duodenal mucosa converts trypsinogen to trypsin, which then activates the other pancreatic proenzymes.

questions.q: Fever with conjunctival suffusion, calf tenderness, jaundice and acute kidney injury after wading in flood water during the monsoon suggests:
questions.why: Weil's disease is the icteric, haemorrhagic and renal form of leptospirosis; conjunctival suffusion and calf tenderness are typical.

questions.q: Chronic bronchitis is defined as a productive cough for at least:
opts: 3 months a year for 2 consecutive years
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Clinical definition.

questions.q: Ascertaining the time of death from the body includes all EXCEPT:
questions.why: Topic 10, Community and Forensic Medicine, Ethics. Blood group does not change with time.
